advisoryText: Under the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order and BIS Act 2016, all Central Ministries, CPSEs, and GeM buyers are required to reference applicable Indian Standards (IS) and mandatory Quality Control Orders (QCO) in technical tenders.
alliedInstallationDesc: Engineering codes for on-site laying, mounting, workmanship, and commissioning.
alliedNormativeDesc: Foundational parent standards and raw material specifications cited in the code.
alliedSafetyDesc: Mandatory fire resistance, dielectric limits, hazard safeguards, and PPE.
alliedTerminologyDesc: Standardized engineering vocabulary, classifications, and nomenclature.
alliedTestMethodDesc: Protocols for testing, laboratory sampling, chemical analysis, and verification.
authority.default_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards & Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Govt. of India
feat1Text: Paste tender BoQ lines in English, Hindi, or 6 other Indian state languages. Automatic translation preserves technical domain vocabulary for accurate indexing.
feat2Text: Instantly identify whether a standard falls under BIS ISI Product Certification, Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS), or Hallmarking — with source citations.
feat3Text: Explore connected test methods, safety codes, installation standards, and normative references — grouped by engineering relationship type.
inputDescription: Enter tender schedule BoQ items, GeM product parameters, or engineering descriptions to discover mandatory BIS Indian Standards.

introText: Enter your tender specification, GeM product description, or engineering parameters above. The Manak Mitra engine cross-references the BIS technical catalogue and returns ranked Indian Standards with certification requirements and regulatory mandates.

procAuditDesc: Public tenders must stipulate relevant IS specifications. Standards under mandatory Quality Control Orders (QCO) require valid BIS certification prior to supply.
sample1Query: Procurement of 3-core copper conductor flexible PVC insulated and sheathed power cable, 1100V grade for indoor institutional electrification and distribution panel wiring conforming to national building standards.
sample2Query: Supply of Grade 43/53 Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) and Portland Pozzolana Cement for structural foundation, RCC beam casting, and high-strength culvert construction with rapid hardening property.
sample3Query: Purchase of industrial safety helmets made of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) with shock absorption test compliance, adjustable chin straps, and dielectric protection for construction site personnel.
sample4Query: Outdoor LED street lighting luminaires 90W to 120W with built-in electronic controlgear, IP66 waterproof enclosure, and 10kV surge protection device for municipal smart city roadway illumination.
sample4Title: LED Street Lighting Luminaires with Surge Protection
sample5Query: Procurement specification for gold bars, 22-carat gold coin medallions, and precious metal assaying with certified purity testing and six-digit alphanumeric HUID hallmarking conformity.
